name: toast
title: Toast
description: shadcn/ui's base-nova toast, fixed: A dialog's radius (rounded-xl, not 2xl) and no border: shadow-lg is the theme's shadow-float, which has its own hairline. Toaster takes position (bottom-end, or top-end under AgentApp's titlebar and the status bar), --toast-inset-end on the root to keep clear of the window's end, and pinned, a card that stays where the toasts show. It moves by the theme's motion-slide on --ease-enter, its height by motion-fade.
